sections.en:
1 κυριακήν ('Sunday') the codex has, we have corrected. 2 πολεμηθεῖ ('he will be warred against') the codex has. 3 βλαβεῖ ('he will be harmed') the codex has. ἅπται ('he touches') the codex has.
4 ἔλαιος ('oil') the codex has. 5 ἀλήφου ('anoint!') the codex has and thus everywhere. 7 τοῦ ♊ ('of the Gemini') the codex has, τῶν Διδύμων ('of the Twins') we have writ-
ten. 8 ἐπίνοσον ('sickly') the codex has. Then ἔτη ('years') we have enclosed in brackets. ἔνει ('is in') the codex has. 9 καλῶς ('well') the codex has.
εὐηδής ('sweet') the codex has. 10 φουμιστής ('fumigator'?), which is found here and on p. 169, l. 3, what it means, we do not
know. πάντως ('altogether') the codex has, as it seems. πεγνιότης ('playfulness') the codex has. 12 πράξεις ('actions') the codex has. τιμήσεις ('honors') the codex has.
13 ἐκφυγεῖς ('you will escape') the codex has. μεγάλως ('greatly') the codex has, corrected by Kroll. 14 πτωχίαν ('poverty') the codex has. ἴδει ('he sees') the codex has. 17 στή-
σεται ('he will stand') the codex has, corrected by Kroll. 18 μελιχρήν ('honey-colored') the codex has. λᾶ' ('take') the codex has and thus everywhere; λάβῃ ('he may take') we have written.
θάψη ('he may bury') the codex has. 20 λάβη ('he may take') the codex has. 21 καὶ ὁ νοῦς ('and the mind') the codex has, καὶ τὸ οὖς ('and the ear') we have written. 22 ἔχει ('he has') the codex has,
ἕξει ('he will have') we have written. 23 ἀρρωστεῖ ('he is sick') the codex has, ἀρρωστήσει ('he will be sick') we have written. 24 ἀλήφεται ('he is anointed') the codex has.
26 τοῦ ('of the') the codex has.. τῶν ('of the') we have written. Διδύμων ('Twins') supplied. 27 ἕως ('until') supplied. 28 ἀνδρί ('to a man') the codex has.
29 γωνικόν ('angular') the codex has. Or οἶκον γον. ('angular house')? κληρομήσει ('he will inherit') the codex has. 30 κτίσεται ('he will build') the codex has. 31 πολ-
λυκάματος ('of much toil') the codex has. 32 ἔχει ('he has') the codex has, ἕξει ('he will have') we have written.

summary.headline: Gemini Birth Prognostications
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for people born under Gemini, covering appearance, character, longevity, marriage, offspring, dangers, illnesses, livelihood, and remedies involving liturgy, saints, herbs, oil, and incense. The text includes separate predictions for a Gemini-born boy and girl.
